question: Where should Spotify put the next quarter of product effort: access, usability, playback, or billing/support?

evidence.quote: App is awful and broken. Podcasts randomly stop, also can no longer use skip/play/stop because the neccessary buttons no longer show up. Have to force close the
Since last update, podcasts stop literally every 10 minutes and the display screen is gone so you can't skip forward or back, view queue, add to queue.

recommendations.rationale: Customers report missing skip, play and shuffle controls and a broken interface after updates; playback_controls has the higher mean_severity among the usability issues.
recommendations.title: Fix playback controls and interface regressions after updates

evidence.quote: But even though the ad was over, the timer was still counting up.

recommendations.rationale: Ads and repeated songs are the largest usability issue by complaint count and severity_sum, though its mean_severity is lower.
recommendations.title: Review the ad experience, including timer behaviour

evidence.quote: Logged out of my account and the app is completely frozen on the loading screen. Uninstalled and re-installed as well as updated the app and nothing is working.

recommendations.rationale: Customers report the app stuck on the loading screen or not opening, and this is the second-largest usability issue by severity_sum.
recommendations.title: Investigate app freezing and failure to open
